6928/// `KernelSignalWait` against a scripted guest and a scripted `/proc` read
6929/// (`signal_state_read_seam`). No failure of the wait's signal handling may reach
6930/// the guest as an errno its wait call cannot return, and the guest must never
6931/// resume with every signal blocked
6932/// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3146).
6933#[cfg(test)]
6934mod kernel_signal_wait_failures {
6935    use std::collections::VecDeque;
6936    use std::sync::Arc;
6937    use std::sync::Mutex;
6938
6939    use reverie::GlobalRPC;
6940    use reverie::GlobalTool;
6941    use reverie::Pid;
6942    use reverie::syscalls::LocalMemory;
6943
6944    use super::*;
6945    use crate::Config;
6946    use crate::GlobalState;
6947    use crate::ThreadState;
6948    use crate::syscalls::threads::KernelSignalState;
6949    use crate::syscalls::threads::kernel_sigset_bit;
6950    use crate::syscalls::threads::signal_state_read_seam;
6951    use crate::types::DetPid;
6952
6953    /// What an injected `rt_sigprocmask` does.
6954    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
6955    enum MaskOutcome {
6956        /// The call runs: the mask changes and it returns 0.
6957        Apply,
6958        /// A signal stops the guest before the call runs: the mask is unchanged
6959        /// and the backend reports its restart errno.
6960        StoppedBefore,
6961        /// The call cannot run at all.
6962        Fail(Errno),
6963        /// `StoppedBefore`, by a signal that `/proc` never showed because it
6964        /// arrived after the read before the injection, such as a `SIGSTOP`
6965        /// sent from outside: the backend holds it in its single slot
6966        /// (`FakeKernel::held_slot`).
6967        StoppedBy(i32),
6968    }
6969
6970    /// The kernel's view of the guest thread, shared by the scripted `/proc`
6971    /// read and the scripted guest.
6972    #[derive(Default)]
6973    struct FakeKernel {
6974        /// The thread's mask (`SigBlk`).
6975        blocked: KernelSigset,
6976        /// Pending signals (`SigPnd | ShdPnd`).
6977        pending: KernelSigset,
6978        /// The signals of `pending` pending only on the thread group's shared
6979        /// queue (`ShdPnd`); every other one is on the thread's own
6980        /// (`SigPnd`).
6981        shared: KernelSigset,
6982        /// Signals with a handler (`SigCgt`).
6983        caught: KernelSigset,
6984        /// Signals whose disposition is `SIG_IGN` (`SigIgn`).
6985        ignored: KernelSigset,
6986        /// Whether a pending signal outside the mask stops each injection before
6987        /// the call runs, as on ptrace, where an ignored signal still queues for
6988        /// a traced task: it leaves the queue for the backend to hold
6989        /// (`taken`), and the injection reports a restart errno.
6990        stops_for_pending: bool,
6991        /// The signals that stopped an injection, in order.
6992        taken: Vec<i32>,
6993        /// Errors for the next reads, one per read.
6994        read_failures: VecDeque<Errno>,
6995        /// Outcomes for the next `rt_sigprocmask` calls; `Apply` once empty.
6996        outcomes: VecDeque<MaskOutcome>,
6997        /// Every mask the guest was asked to set, in order.
6998        requested: Vec<KernelSigset>,
6999        /// How many more signals that stop an injection are sent again, as by
7000        /// a sender faster than the injections: each such signal is pending
7001        /// again from the read after the one that follows the stop, which still
7002        /// shows it gone, so the stop is identified (`pending_repost`).
7003        repost_after_take: usize,
7004        /// The signals sent again, which the read after the next one shows.
7005        pending_repost: KernelSigset,
7006        /// The backend's one slot for a held signal: each signal that stops an
7007        /// injection (`taken`, `MaskOutcome::StoppedBy`) replaces the one there,
7008        /// as Reverie's ptrace backend does (`hold_pending_signal`).
7009        held_slot: Option<i32>,
7010        /// The signals that a stop dropped from `held_slot`, in order. A standard
7011        /// signal that replaces itself is merged, as Linux merges a second one
7012        /// sent while the first is pending, and is not lost.
7013        lost: Vec<i32>,
7014        /// Answers for the next `Guest::set_blocked_signals` calls: `None`
7015        /// sets the mask and returns the old one; once empty, every call is
7016        /// refused as `Unsupported`, as the trait's default refuses.
7017        setter: VecDeque<Option<MaskChangeRefused>>,
7018        /// Every mask `Guest::set_blocked_signals` was asked to set, in order.
7019        set_calls: Vec<KernelSigset>,
7020        /// The scheduler's answer to `HostTimedAndPrivateSigchld`: the
7021        /// host-timed signals, then the recorded private `SIGCHLD`. `None`
7022        /// panics, as every other request does.
7023        private_record: Option<(KernelSigset, KernelSigset)>,
7024    }
7025
7026    impl FakeKernel {
7027        /// The backend holds `signal`, which stopped an injection.
7028        fn hold(&mut self, signal: i32) {
7029            if let Some(previous) = self.held_slot.replace(signal)
7030                && !(previous == signal && signal < KERNEL_SIGRTMIN)
7031            {
7032                self.lost.push(previous);
7033            }
7034        }
7035    }
7036
7037    type Kernel = Arc<Mutex<FakeKernel>>;
7038
7039    /// Room for one mask, 8-byte aligned like a real stack slot.
7040    const ARENA_WORDS: usize = 2;
7041
7042    /// A scratch stack in this process's memory whose commit can fail like the
7043    /// ptrace scratch below an `rsp` with no writable memory under it
7044    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3328).
7045    struct WaitStack {
7046        commit_fails: bool,
7047        arena: usize,
7048    }
7049
7050    struct WaitStackGuard;
7051
7052    impl Drop for WaitStackGuard {
7053        fn drop(&mut self) {}
7054    }
7055
7056    impl reverie::Stack for WaitStack {
7057        type StackGuard = WaitStackGuard;
7058
7059        fn size(&self) -> usize {
7060            panic!("a blocked wait must not query the scratch size")
7061        }
7062        fn capacity(&self) -> usize {
7063            panic!("a blocked wait must not query the scratch capacity")
7064        }
7065        fn push<'stack, T>(&mut self, value: T) -> Addr<'stack, T> {
7066            assert!(std::mem::size_of::<T>() <= ARENA_WORDS * std::mem::size_of::<u64>());
7067            // SAFETY: the arena is a live, 8-byte aligned buffer owned by the guest,
7068            // large enough for `T` (asserted above).
7069            unsafe { std::ptr::write(self.arena as *mut T, value) };
7070            Addr::from_raw(self.arena).unwrap()
7071        }
7072        fn reserve<'stack, T>(&mut self) -> AddrMut<'stack, T> {
7073            panic!("a blocked wait pushes its mask rather than reserving room")
7074        }
7075        fn commit(self) -> Result<Self::StackGuard, Errno> {
7076            if self.commit_fails {
7077                Err(Errno::EFAULT)
7078            } else {
7079                Ok(WaitStackGuard)
7080            }
7081        }
7082    }
7083
7084    struct WaitGuest {
7085        config: Config,
7086        thread: ThreadState<()>,
7087        pid: Pid,
7088        tid: Pid,
7089        commit_fails: bool,
7090        arena: Box<[u64; ARENA_WORDS]>,
7091        kernel: Kernel,
7092    }
7093
7094    impl WaitGuest {
7095        /// A guest for thread `tid` of this process, with the guest's own `mask`
7096        /// installed.
7097        fn new(tid: Pid, mask: KernelSigset) -> (Self, Kernel) {
7098            let config = Config::default();
7099            let thread = ThreadState::new(DetPid::from_raw(1), &config, ());
7100            let kernel = Arc::new(Mutex::new(FakeKernel {
7101                blocked: mask,
7102                ..FakeKernel::default()
7103            }));
7104            let guest = Self {
7105                config,
7106                thread,
7107                pid: Pid::from_raw(std::process::id() as i32),
7108                tid,
7109                commit_fails: false,
7110                arena: Box::new([u64::MAX; ARENA_WORDS]),
7111                kernel: kernel.clone(),
7112            };
7113            (guest, kernel)
7114        }
7115
7116        /// A guest for the calling thread, which exists.
7117        fn live(mask: KernelSigset) -> (Self, Kernel) {
7118            // SAFETY: gettid has no preconditions.
7119            Self::new(Pid::from_raw(unsafe { libc::gettid() }), mask)
7120        }
7121    }
7122
7123    /// The decision `ioaction_based_on_fd_status` takes from the call's own
7124    /// flags. On a socket the guest left blocking, which Detcore keeps
7125    /// physically nonblocking, a send or receive is retried until it stops
7126    /// failing with `EAGAIN` (`NonblockizeRetry`), unless its flags carry
7127    /// `MSG_DONTWAIT`: then it runs once (`PassThru`), as Linux runs it.
7128    /// recvmmsg's `MSG_WAITFORONE` alone still waits for the first datagram.
7129    /// On a socket the guest made `O_NONBLOCK`, every call runs once, and on
7130    /// one Detcore leaves physically blocking every call takes the blocking
7131    /// path.
7132    #[test]
7133    fn msg_dontwait_runs_a_call_once_on_a_socket_the_guest_left_blocking() {
7134        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
7135
7136        use reverie::syscalls::Recvfrom;
7137        use reverie::syscalls::Recvmmsg;
7138        use reverie::syscalls::Recvmsg;
7139        use reverie::syscalls::Sendmmsg;
7140        use reverie::syscalls::Sendmsg;
7141        use reverie::syscalls::Sendto;
7142
7143        let (mut guest, _) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7144        let (socket, _peer) = std::os::unix::net::UnixDatagram::pair().unwrap();
7145        let fd = socket.as_raw_fd();
7146        guest
7147            .thread
7148            .add_fd(fd, nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDWR, FdType::Socket, None)
7149            .unwrap();
7150        let dontwait = libc::MSG_DONTWAIT;
7151        let waitforone = libc::MSG_WAITFORONE;
7152        let once = Ok(IOAction::PassThru);
7153        let retry = Ok(IOAction::NonblockizeRetry);
7154        let decisions = |guest: &mut WaitGuest| {
7155            [
7156                (
7157                    "recvfrom",
7158                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7159                        guest,
7160                        Recvfrom::new().with_fd(fd).with_flags(dontwait),
7161                    ),
7162                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(guest, Recvfrom::new().with_fd(fd)),
7163                ),
7164                (
7165                    "recvmsg",
7166                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7167                        guest,
7168                        Recvmsg::new().with_sockfd(fd).with_flags(dontwait),
7169                    ),
7170                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(guest, Recvmsg::new().with_sockfd(fd)),
7171                ),
7172                (
7173                    "recvmmsg",
7174                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7175                        guest,
7176                        Recvmmsg::new()
7177                            .with_fd(fd)
7178                            .with_flags((waitforone | dontwait) as u32),
7179                    ),
7180                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7181                        guest,
7182                        Recvmmsg::new().with_fd(fd).with_flags(waitforone as u32),
7183                    ),
7184                ),
7185                (
7186                    "sendto",
7187                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7188                        guest,
7189                        Sendto::new().with_fd(fd).with_flags(dontwait as u32),
7190                    ),
7191                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(guest, Sendto::new().with_fd(fd)),
7192                ),
7193                (
7194                    "sendmsg",
7195                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7196                        guest,
7197                        Sendmsg::new().with_fd(fd).with_flags(dontwait),
7198                    ),
7199                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(guest, Sendmsg::new().with_fd(fd)),
7200                ),
7201                (
7202                    "sendmmsg",
7203                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(
7204                        guest,
7205                        Sendmmsg::new().with_sockfd(fd).with_flags(dontwait),
7206                    ),
7207                    ioaction_based_on_fd_status(guest, Sendmmsg::new().with_sockfd(fd)),
7208                ),
7209            ]
7210        };
7211        // A socket Detcore leaves physically blocking (an external socket
7212        // under record and replay) keeps the blocking path, flag or not.
7213        for (name, with_dontwait, without) in decisions(&mut guest) {
7214            let blocking = Ok(IOAction::Blocking);
7215            assert_eq!(
7216                with_dontwait, blocking,
7217                "{name} with MSG_DONTWAIT, blocking"
7218            );
7219            assert_eq!(without, blocking, "{name} without MSG_DONTWAIT, blocking");
7220        }
7221        guest
7222            .thread
7223            .with_detfd(fd, |d| d.set_physically_nonblocking())
7224            .unwrap();
7225        for (name, with_dontwait, without) in decisions(&mut guest) {
7226            assert_eq!(with_dontwait, once, "{name} with MSG_DONTWAIT");
7227            assert_eq!(without, retry, "{name} without MSG_DONTWAIT");
7228        }
7229        guest
7230            .thread
7231            .with_detfd(fd, |d| d.set_nonblocking(true))
7232            .unwrap();
7233        for (name, with_dontwait, without) in decisions(&mut guest) {
7234            assert_eq!(with_dontwait, once, "{name} with MSG_DONTWAIT, O_NONBLOCK");
7235            assert_eq!(without, once, "{name} without MSG_DONTWAIT, O_NONBLOCK");
7236        }
7237    }

7239    #[test]
7240    fn inherited_input_exempts_only_authenticated_reads_from_the_internal_guard() {
7241        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
7242        let (mut guest, _) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7243        let slot = tempfile::tempfile().unwrap();
7244        let fd = slot.as_raw_fd();
7245        let input = reverie::InheritedInput::pipe(fd).unwrap();
7246        let identity = input.identity().clone();
7247        let (reader, _writer) = input.into_reader_and_writer();
7248        assert_eq!(unsafe { libc::dup2(reader.as_raw_fd(), fd) }, fd);
7249        guest
7250            .thread
7251            .add_fd(fd, nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDONLY, FdType::Pipe, None)
7252            .unwrap();
7253        let calls = [
7254            Syscall::from(syscalls::Read::new().with_fd(fd)),
7255            Syscall::from(syscalls::Readv::new().with_fd(fd)),
7256            Syscall::from(syscalls::Write::new().with_fd(fd)),
7257            Syscall::from(syscalls::Writev::new().with_fd(fd)),
7258        ];
7259        for call in calls {
7260            assert!(syscall_targets_internal_fd(&mut guest, call));
7261        }
7262        guest
7263            .thread
7264            .file_metadata
7265            .lock()
7266            .unwrap()
7267            .apply_exec_fd_state(
7268                guest.thread.dettid,
7269                crate::tool_local::ExecFdState {
7270                    initial_input: Some(identity),
7271                    ..Default::default()
7272                },
7273                true,
7274            )
7275            .unwrap();
7276        for (index, call) in calls.into_iter().enumerate() {
7277            assert_eq!(syscall_targets_internal_fd(&mut guest, call), index >= 2);
7278        }
7279        assert!(
7280            !guest
7281                .thread
7282                .with_detfd(fd, |d| d.physically_nonblocking())
7283                .unwrap()
7284        );
7285        assert_eq!(
7286            unsafe { libc::fcntl(fd, libc::F_GETFL) } & libc::O_NONBLOCK,
7287            0
7288        );
7289        let (internal, _writer) = nix::unistd::pipe().unwrap();
7290        guest
7291            .thread
7292            .add_fd(
7293                internal.as_raw_fd(),
7294                nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDONLY,
7295                FdType::Pipe,
7296                None,
7297            )
7298            .unwrap();
7299        assert!(syscall_targets_internal_fd(
7300            &mut guest,
7301            syscalls::Read::new().with_fd(internal.as_raw_fd()).into()
7302        ));
7303        // Socketpair ownership remains internal as well.
7304        let (socket, _peer) = std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
7305        guest
7306            .thread
7307            .add_fd(
7308                socket.as_raw_fd(),
7309                nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDWR,
7310                FdType::Socket,
7311                None,
7312            )
7313            .unwrap();
7314        guest
7315            .thread
7316            .with_detfd(socket.as_raw_fd(), |d| d.set_socketpair_endpoint())
7317            .unwrap();
7318        assert!(syscall_targets_internal_fd(
7319            &mut guest,
7320            syscalls::Readv::new().with_fd(socket.as_raw_fd()).into()
7321        ));
7322    }

7324    #[test]
7325    fn a_socketpair_poll_uses_revocable_provenance_without_changing_internal_routing() {
7326        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
7327
7328        use nix::sys::socket::AddressFamily;
7329        use nix::sys::socket::SockFlag;
7330        use nix::sys::socket::SockType;
7331        use nix::sys::socket::socketpair;
7332
7333        let (mut guest, _) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7334        let pairs = [SockType::Datagram, SockType::Stream, SockType::SeqPacket].map(|kind| {
7335            let (socket, peer) =
7336                socketpair(AddressFamily::Unix, kind, None, SockFlag::empty()).unwrap();
7337            (kind, socket, peer)
7338        });
7339        for (kind, socket, _peer) in &pairs {
7340            let fd = socket.as_raw_fd();
7341            guest
7342                .thread
7343                .add_fd(fd, nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDWR, FdType::Socket, None)
7344                .unwrap();
7345            let alias = guest
7346                .thread
7347                .with_detfd(fd, |d| {
7348                    d.set_socketpair_endpoint();
7349                    d.clone()
7350                })
7351                .unwrap();
7352            // Datagram pairs are deliberately not guest-held at creation:
7353            // binding and AF_UNSPEC disconnect can admit outside senders.
7354            // Connected stream/seqpacket pairs have the stronger mark.
7355            let connection = *kind != SockType::Datagram;
7356            if connection {
7357                alias.set_guest_held();
7358            }
7359            let calls = [
7360                syscalls::Read::new().with_fd(fd).into(),
7361                syscalls::Readv::new().with_fd(fd).into(),
7362                syscalls::Recvfrom::new().with_fd(fd).into(),
7363                syscalls::Recvmsg::new().with_sockfd(fd).into(),
7364            ];
7365            for call in calls {
7366                let internal = syscall_targets_internal_fd(&mut guest, call);
7367                assert!(internal, "{kind:?}: live record/replay routing is retained");
7368                let readiness = single_fd_poll_readiness(&mut guest, call, internal);
7369                assert_eq!(
7370                    readiness,
7371                    (connection, connection),
7372                    "{kind:?}: readiness needs revocable provenance"
7373                );
7374                let mut request = Resources::new(DetTid::from_raw(5));
7375                request.insert(ResourceID::InternalIOPolling, Permission::W);
7376                request.poll_attempt = 1;
7377                (
7378                    request.polls_guest_state_only,
7379                    request.relies_on_guest_held_marks,
7380                ) = readiness;
7381                crate::scheduler::assert_poll_export_revocation_for_test(request, connection);
7382            }
7383            // Cached record/replay peer credentials are another routing fact,
7384            // and must not override a socketpair's readiness provenance either.
7385            alias.set_guest_peer();
7386            for call in calls {
7387                let internal = syscall_targets_internal_fd(&mut guest, call);
7388                assert_eq!(
7389                    single_fd_poll_readiness(&mut guest, call, internal),
7390                    (connection, connection),
7391                    "cached guest-peer routing is not socketpair readiness proof"
7392                );
7393            }
7394            alias.clear_guest_held();
7395            for call in calls {
7396                let internal = syscall_targets_internal_fd(&mut guest, call);
7397                assert!(internal, "revocation must not change live routing");
7398                assert_eq!(
7399                    single_fd_poll_readiness(&mut guest, call, internal),
7400                    (false, false),
7401                    "withdrawing a mark through an alias withdraws readiness"
7402                );
7403            }
7404        }
7405
7406        // The socketpair repair does not reclassify other internal descriptors.
7407        let (pipe, _writer) = nix::unistd::pipe().unwrap();
7408        guest
7409            .thread
7410            .add_fd(
7411                pipe.as_raw_fd(),
7412                nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDONLY,
7413                FdType::Pipe,
7414                None,
7415            )
7416            .unwrap();
7417        let (socket, _peer) = std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
7418        guest
7419            .thread
7420            .add_fd(
7421                socket.as_raw_fd(),
7422                nix::fcntl::OFlag::O_RDWR,
7423                FdType::Socket,
7424                None,
7425            )
7426            .unwrap();
7427        guest
7428            .thread
7429            .with_detfd(socket.as_raw_fd(), |d| d.set_guest_peer())
7430            .unwrap();
7431        for fd in [pipe.as_raw_fd(), socket.as_raw_fd()] {
7432            let call = syscalls::Read::new().with_fd(fd).into();
7433            let internal = syscall_targets_internal_fd(&mut guest, call);
7434            assert!(internal);
7435            assert_eq!(
7436                single_fd_poll_readiness(&mut guest, call, internal),
7437                (true, false)
7438            );
7439        }
7440    }

7442    /// Answer this thread's `/proc` reads from `kernel` until the result drops.
7443    fn scripted_proc(kernel: &Kernel) -> signal_state_read_seam::Installed {
7444        let kernel = kernel.clone();
7445        signal_state_read_seam::install(move |_, _| {
7446            let mut kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
7447            let read = match kernel.read_failures.pop_front() {
7448                Some(errno) => Err(errno),
7449                None => Ok(KernelSignalState {
7450                    pending: kernel.pending,
7451                    thread_pending: kernel.pending & !kernel.shared,
7452                    shared_pending: kernel.pending & kernel.shared,
7453                    blocked: kernel.blocked,
7454                    caught: kernel.caught,
7455                    ignored: kernel.ignored,
7456                }),
7457            };
7458            kernel.pending |= std::mem::take(&mut kernel.pending_repost);
7459            Some(read)
7460        })
7461    }

7463    #[reverie::tool]
7464    impl GlobalRPC<GlobalState> for WaitGuest {
7465        async fn send_rpc(
7466            &self,
7467            message: <GlobalState as GlobalTool>::Request,
7468        ) -> <GlobalState as GlobalTool>::Response {
7469            match (&message.2, self.kernel.lock().unwrap().private_record) {
7470                (
7471                    crate::tool_global::GlobalRequest::HostTimedAndPrivateSigchld(_),
7472                    Some((host_timed, private)),
7473                ) => (
7474                    None,
7475                    crate::tool_global::GlobalResponse::HostTimedAndPrivateSigchld(
7476                        host_timed, private,
7477                    ),
7478                ),
7479                _ => panic!("these waits must not send an RPC: {:?}", message.2),
7480            }
7481        }
7482        fn config(&self) -> &Config {
7483            &self.config
7484        }
7485    }

7487    #[reverie::tool]
7488    impl Guest<Detcore> for WaitGuest {
7489        type Memory = LocalMemory;
7490        type Stack = WaitStack;
7491
7492        fn tid(&self) -> Pid {
7493            self.tid
7494        }
7495        fn pid(&self) -> Pid {
7496            self.pid
7497        }
7498        fn ppid(&self) -> Option<Pid> {
7499            None
7500        }
7501        fn memory(&self) -> Self::Memory {
7502            LocalMemory::new()
7503        }
7504        fn thread_state_mut(&mut self) -> &mut ThreadState<()> {
7505            &mut self.thread
7506        }
7507        fn thread_state(&self) -> &ThreadState<()> {
7508            &self.thread
7509        }
7510        async fn regs(&mut self) -> libc::user_regs_struct {
7511            panic!("a blocked wait must not read registers")
7512        }
7513        async fn stack(&mut self) -> Self::Stack {
7514            WaitStack {
7515                commit_fails: self.commit_fails,
7516                arena: self.arena.as_mut_ptr() as usize,
7517            }
7518        }
7519        async fn daemonize(&mut self) {
7520            panic!("a blocked wait must not daemonize")
7521        }
7522        async fn inject<S: SyscallInfo>(&mut self, syscall: S) -> Result<i64, Errno> {
7523            let (number, args) = syscall.into_parts();
7524            let Syscall::RtSigprocmask(call) = Syscall::from_raw(number, args) else {
7525                panic!("a blocked wait injected {number}, not rt_sigprocmask")
7526            };
7527            assert_eq!(call.how(), libc::SIG_SETMASK);
7528            assert!(call.oldset().is_none());
7529            let set = call.set().expect("rt_sigprocmask without a mask");
7530            let mask: KernelSigset = LocalMemory::new().read_value(set.cast::<KernelSigset>())?;
7531            let mut kernel = self.kernel.lock().unwrap();
7532            kernel.requested.push(mask);
7533            let deliverable = kernel.pending & !kernel.blocked;
7534            if kernel.stops_for_pending && deliverable != 0 {
7535                let signal = deliverable.trailing_zeros() as i32 + 1;
7536                kernel.pending &= !kernel_sigset_bit(signal);
7537                kernel.taken.push(signal);
7538                kernel.hold(signal);
7539                if kernel.repost_after_take > 0 {
7540                    kernel.repost_after_take -= 1;
7541                    kernel.pending_repost |= kernel_sigset_bit(signal);
7542                }
7543                return Err(Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7544            }
7545            match kernel.outcomes.pop_front().unwrap_or(MaskOutcome::Apply) {
7546                MaskOutcome::Apply => {
7547                    kernel.blocked = mask;
7548                    Ok(0)
7549                }
7550                MaskOutcome::StoppedBefore => Err(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR),
7551                MaskOutcome::StoppedBy(signal) => {
7552                    kernel.hold(signal);
7553                    Err(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR)
7554                }
7555                MaskOutcome::Fail(errno) => Err(errno),
7556            }
7557        }
7558        async fn set_blocked_signals(&mut self, mask: u64) -> Result<u64, MaskChangeRefused> {
7559            let mut kernel = self.kernel.lock().unwrap();
7560            kernel.set_calls.push(mask);
7561            match kernel.setter.pop_front() {
7562                Some(None) => Ok(std::mem::replace(&mut kernel.blocked, mask)),
7563                Some(Some(refused)) => Err(refused),
7564                None => Err(MaskChangeRefused::Unsupported),
7565            }
7566        }
7567
7568        async fn tail_inject<S: SyscallInfo>(&mut self, _: S) -> reverie::Never {
7569            panic!("a blocked wait must not retire the guest")
7570        }
7571        fn set_timer(&mut self, _: reverie::TimerSchedule) -> Result<(), Error> {
7572            panic!("a blocked wait must not set a timer")
7573        }
7574        fn set_timer_precise(&mut self, _: reverie::TimerSchedule) -> Result<(), Error> {
7575            panic!("a blocked wait must not set a timer")
7576        }
7577        fn read_clock(&mut self) -> Result<u64, Error> {
7578            panic!("a blocked wait must not read a clock")
7579        }
7580    }

7582    /// The guest's own mask in these tests.
7583    fn guest_mask() -> KernelSigset {
7584        kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR2)
7585    }

7587    /// The diagnostic a result ends the run with.
7588    fn diagnostic<V: std::fmt::Debug>(result: Result<V, Error>) -> BlockedWaitSignalError {
7589        match result {
7590            Err(Error::Tool(error)) => *error
7591                .downcast_ref::<BlockedWaitSignalError>()
7592                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("not a blocked-wait diagnostic: {error:#}")),
7593            other => panic!("expected the run to end with a diagnostic, got {other:?}"),
7594        }
7595    }
7596
7597    /// The held-signal refusal a result ends the wait with.
7598    fn refusal<V: std::fmt::Debug>(result: Result<V, Error>) -> HeldSignalRefusal {
7599        match result {
7600            Err(Error::Tool(error)) => *error
7601                .downcast_ref::<HeldSignalRefusal>()
7602                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("not a held-signal refusal: {error:#}")),
7603            other => panic!("expected the wait to end with a held-signal refusal, got {other:?}"),
7604        }
7605    }

7607    /// A wait whose guest mask `block` replaced with the all-blocked mask.
7608    async fn blocked_wait(guest: &mut WaitGuest, kernel: &Kernel) -> KernelSignalWait {
7609        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7610        wait.block(guest, None).await.unwrap();
7611        assert!(!wait.needs_block());
7612        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().blocked, blocked_signal_mask());
7613        wait
7614    }
7615
7616    /// Each stopped attempt is a stop by a signal that `/proc` cannot identify,
7617    /// which the backend holds in place of the one before. `restore` used to
7618    /// return success here; the second stop drops the first unidentified one,
7619    /// which may matter, so the mask is still put back and the wait now ends
7620    /// with a `HeldSignalRefusal`, as a wait loop that meets two such stops
7621    /// does (round-11 High F1 on
7622    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361).
7623    #[tokio::test]
7624    async fn restore_repeats_the_mask_change_until_the_kernel_reports_it() {
7625        let (mut guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7626        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
7627        let mut wait = blocked_wait(&mut guest, &kernel).await;
7628        kernel
7629            .lock()
7630            .unwrap()
7631            .outcomes
7632            .extend([MaskOutcome::StoppedBefore; 5]);
7633
7634        let result = wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await;
7635
7636        assert_eq!(
7637            refusal(result),
7638            HeldSignalRefusal {
7639                wait: None,
7640                held: None,
7641                replacing: None,
7642                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Restoration,
7643            }
7644        );
7645        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
7646        assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, guest_mask());
7647        assert_eq!(
7648            kernel.requested.len(),
7649            1 + 6,
7650            "block, then five stopped attempts and one that ran"
7651        );
7652        assert!(
7653            kernel.requested[1..]
7654                .iter()
7655                .all(|&mask| mask == guest_mask())
7656        );
7657    }

7660    async fn a_mask_that_signals_keep_stopping_ends_the_run_instead_of_resuming_the_guest() {

7671

7680        );

7716    /// `block_in_place` blocks through `Guest::set_blocked_signals`, with no
7717    /// injection, and `restore` puts the guest's mask back the same way: no
7718    /// scratch memory is touched, so a stack with no room below it (a failing
7719    /// commit) changes nothing (Claude review of the R2b-2 design, M1).
7720    #[tokio::test]
7721    async fn an_in_place_block_and_its_restore_make_no_injection() {
7722        let (mut guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7723        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
7724        guest.commit_fails = true;
7725        kernel.lock().unwrap().setter.extend([None, None]);
7726        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7727        assert!(wait.block_in_place(&mut guest, 0).await.unwrap());
7728        assert_eq!(wait.effective_mask(), Some(guest_mask()));
7729        assert_eq!(
7730            kernel.lock().unwrap().blocked,
7731            blocked_signal_mask() | guest_mask()
7732        );
7733        wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await.unwrap();
7734        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
7735        assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, guest_mask());
7736        assert_eq!(
7737            kernel.set_calls,
7738            vec![blocked_signal_mask() | guest_mask(), guest_mask()]
7739        );
7740        assert!(
7741            kernel.requested.is_empty(),
7742            "no rt_sigprocmask was injected"
7743        );
7744        assert_eq!(wait.effective_mask(), None);
7745    }

7747    /// The in-place block holds the turn's host-timed signals until the call
7748    /// returns (`hold_until_return`), as `install_turn_mask` does for
7749    /// `writev`, so a fallback injected restoration that one of them stops
7750    /// holds it rather than counting it lost (Claude re-check of R2b-2 stage
7751    /// 2, F2).
7752    #[tokio::test]
7753    async fn an_in_place_block_holds_the_host_timed_signals() {
7754        let (mut guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7755        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
7756        kernel.lock().unwrap().setter.push_back(None);
7757        let host_timed = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGIO) | kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGHUP);
7758        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7759        assert!(wait.block_in_place(&mut guest, host_timed).await.unwrap());
7760        assert_eq!(wait.held_until_return & host_timed, host_timed);
7761        assert_eq!(wait.host_timed & host_timed, host_timed);
7762    }

7764    /// A refused in-place block changes nothing: the wait goes on under the
7765    /// guest's own mask, does not try again (`needs_block`), and has nothing
7766    /// to restore.

7768    async fn a_refused_in_place_block_leaves_the_guest_mask() {
7769        let (mut guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7770        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
7771        kernel
7772            .lock()
7773            .unwrap()
7774            .setter
7775            .push_back(Some(MaskChangeRefused::RestorePending {
7776                saved: guest_mask(),
7777                effective: 0,
7778            }));
7779        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7780        assert!(!wait.block_in_place(&mut guest, 0).await.unwrap());
7781        assert!(!wait.needs_block());
7782        assert_eq!(wait.effective_mask(), None);
7783        wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await.unwrap();
7784        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
7785        assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, guest_mask());
7786        assert_eq!(kernel.set_calls.len(), 1);
7787        assert!(kernel.requested.is_empty());

7811    /// before the guest resumes.

7815            errno: Errno::EIO,
7816            mask_unknown: true,
7817        });

7819        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
7820        let not_restored = BlockedWaitSignalError::MaskNotRestored {
7821            pid: guest.pid,
7822            tid: guest.tid,

7828        assert_eq!(
7829            diagnostic(wait.block_in_place(&mut guest, 0).await),

7833        kernel.lock().unwrap().setter.extend([None, unknown]);
7834        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7835        assert!(wait.block_in_place(&mut guest, 0).await.unwrap());
7836        assert_eq!(
7837            diagnostic(wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await),
7838            not_restored

7876    #[tokio::test]
7877    async fn an_unreadable_signal_state_of_a_live_thread_ends_the_run() {
7878        let (mut guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7879        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
7880        let (pid, tid) = (guest.pid, guest.tid);
7881        let expected = |errno| BlockedWaitSignalError::StateUnreadable { pid, tid, errno };
7882
7883        // The turn's check, before the mask is set.
7884        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7885        kernel.lock().unwrap().read_failures.push_back(Errno::EIO);
7886        assert_eq!(diagnostic(wait.interrupted()), expected(Errno::EIO));
7887
7888        // `block`'s read of the guest's mask.
7889        kernel.lock().unwrap().read_failures.push_back(Errno::ESRCH);
7890        assert_eq!(
7891            diagnostic(wait.block(&mut guest, None).await),
7892            expected(Errno::ESRCH)
7893        );
7894        assert!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.is_empty());
7895
7896        // `restore`'s read, with every signal blocked.
7897        wait.block(&mut guest, None).await.unwrap();
7898        kernel.lock().unwrap().read_failures.push_back(Errno::ESRCH);
7899        assert_eq!(
7900            diagnostic(wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await),
7901            expected(Errno::ESRCH)
7902        );
7903        let error = expected(Errno::EIO).to_string();
7904        assert!(
7905            error.starts_with("cannot read the signal state of guest thread"),
7906            "{error}"
7907        );
7908    }

7910    #[tokio::test]
7911    async fn a_thread_that_no_longer_exists_ends_its_wait_with_erestartnointr() {
7912        // SAFETY: gettid has no preconditions.
7913        let exited = std::thread::spawn(|| unsafe { libc::gettid() })
7914            .join()
7915            .unwrap();
7916        // `join` returns when the kernel clears the thread's TID word, early in
7917        // its exit; the thread stays in `/proc` and answers `tgkill` until the
7918        // kernel releases it a moment later. Measured on the development host,
7919        // 62 of 20000 joined threads were still listed right after `join`, and
7920        // a GitHub-hosted run read such a thread's status here
7921        // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/actions/runs/37683205050). So wait
7922        // for the release. The path is in this process's own task directory, so
7923        // no other process's thread can appear under it, and Linux hands out
7924        // TIDs cyclically, so this one is not reissued here before the counter
7925        // wraps.
7926        let task = format!("/proc/self/task/{exited}");
7927        let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + std::time::Duration::from_secs(10);
7928        while std::path::Path::new(&task).exists() {
7929            assert!(
7930                std::time::Instant::now() < deadline,
7931                "thread {exited} is still in /proc 10 s after it was joined"
7932            );
7933            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(1));
7934        }
7935        let (guest, _kernel) = WaitGuest::new(Pid::from_raw(exited), guest_mask());
7936        // No script: the read goes to the real `/proc`, where the thread is gone.
7937
7938        let wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
7939        assert!(matches!(
7940            wait.interrupted(),
7941            Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR))
7942        ));
7943        assert!(matches!(
7944            read_wait_signal_state(guest.pid, guest.tid),
7945            Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR))
7946        ));
7947    }

7952        guest.commit_fails = true;

7960        assert!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.is_empty());
7961
7962        // Later turns classify against the guest's own mask, read each turn.
7963        {
7964            let mut kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
7965            kernel.caught = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1) | kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR2);
7966            kernel.pending = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR2);
7967        }
7968        assert!(!wait.interrupted().unwrap(), "SIGUSR2 is blocked");
7969        kernel.lock().unwrap().pending = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
7970        assert!(wait.interrupted().unwrap(), "SIGUSR1 is not blocked");
7971
7972        wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await.unwrap();
7973        assert!(
7974            kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.is_empty(),
7975            "nothing to put back"
7976        );
7977        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().blocked, guest_mask());
7978    }
7979
7980    /// A guest whose injections a pending signal outside the mask stops, as on
7981    /// ptrace, with `pending` queued and `ignored` set to `SIG_IGN`.
7982    fn stopping_guest(pending: KernelSigset, ignored: KernelSigset) -> (WaitGuest, Kernel) {
7983        let (guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
7984        {
7985            let mut kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
7986            kernel.stops_for_pending = true;
7987            kernel.pending = pending;
7988            kernel.ignored = ignored;
7989        }
7990        (guest, kernel)
7991    }
7992
7993    /// Inject a mask change to `mask` through `wait.inject_absorbing`.
7994    async fn inject_mask_absorbing(
7995        wait: &mut KernelSignalWait,
7996        guest: &mut WaitGuest,
7997        mask: KernelSigset,
7998    ) -> Result<Result<i64, Errno>, Error> {
7999        let mut stack = guest.stack().await;
8000        let cell = stack.push(mask);
8001        let _guard = stack.commit().unwrap();
8002        wait.inject_absorbing(guest, set_signal_mask_call(cell))
8003            .await
8004    }
8005
8006    /// An ignored signal that was already pending stops the mask change of
8007    /// `block`, which used to end the wait with a restart (review finding F2 on
8008    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361). Linux would not end the
8009    /// wait for it, so the stop is absorbed: the backend holds the signal, the
8010    /// change runs again, and the held signal does not interrupt the wait.
8011    #[tokio::test]
8012    async fn an_ignored_signal_that_stops_the_mask_change_does_not_end_the_wait() {
8013        let usr1 = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
8014        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(usr1, usr1);
8015        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8016        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8017
8018        wait.block(&mut guest, None).await.unwrap();
8019
8020        assert!(!wait.needs_block());
8021        let all_blocked = blocked_signal_mask() | guest_mask();
8022        {
8023            let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8024            assert_eq!(kernel.taken, vec![libc::SIGUSR1]);
8025            assert_eq!(kernel.requested, vec![all_blocked, all_blocked]);
8026            assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, all_blocked);
8027        }
8028        assert_eq!(
8029            wait.held,
8030            Some(HeldSignal {
8031                signal: libc::SIGUSR1,
8032                queue: SignalQueue::Thread,
8033                kind: HeldKind::Harmless,
8034            })
8035        );
8036        assert!(
8037            !wait.interrupted().unwrap(),
8038            "an ignored signal does not end the wait"
8039        );
8040        wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await.unwrap();
8041        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().blocked, guest_mask());
8042    }
8043
8044    /// A default-ignored signal that stops an injection is held the same way,
8045    /// and the injection then returns its own result (review finding F2 on
8046    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361).
8047    #[tokio::test]
8048    async fn a_default_ignored_signal_that_stops_an_injection_is_held() {
8049        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH), 0);
8050        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8051        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8052
8053        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8054
8055        assert!(matches!(result, Ok(Ok(0))), "{result:?}");
8056        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().taken, vec![libc::SIGWINCH]);
8057        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.len(), 2);
8058        assert_eq!(wait.held.map(|held| held.kind), Some(HeldKind::Harmless));
8059        assert!(!wait.interrupted().unwrap());
8060    }

8062    /// A pending signal that would end the wait natively ends it before any
8063    /// injection, with the restart errno, and stays queued for the guest.
8064    #[tokio::test]
8065    async fn a_pending_caught_signal_ends_the_wait_before_the_injection() {
8066        let usr1 = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
8067        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(usr1, 0);
8068        kernel.lock().unwrap().caught = usr1;
8069        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8070        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8071
8072        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8073
8074        assert!(
8075            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTSYS))),
8076            "{result:?}"
8077        );
8078        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8079        assert!(kernel.requested.is_empty(), "nothing is injected");
8080        assert_eq!(kernel.pending, usr1);
8081        assert_eq!(wait.held, None);
8082    }
8083
8084    /// The backend holds one signal. Once it holds one whose loss would matter,
8085    /// a `SIGCHLD` here, an injection that a different pending signal would stop
8086    /// is not made. The wait used to end with `ERESTARTNOINTR`, a transparent
8087    /// restart; it now ends with a `HeldSignalRefusal`, which its caller turns
8088    /// into the unsupported-operation refusal (round-10 High 1 on
8089    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361).
8090    #[tokio::test]
8091    async fn a_held_sigchld_is_never_replaced_by_another_stop() {
8092        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(
8093            kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGCHLD) | kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH),
8094            0,
8095        );
8096        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8097        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8098
8099        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8100
8101        assert_eq!(
8102            refusal(result),
8103            HeldSignalRefusal {
8104                wait: None,
8105                held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8106                replacing: Some(libc::SIGWINCH),
8107                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Replaced,
8108            }
8109        );
8110        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8111        assert_eq!(kernel.taken, vec![libc::SIGCHLD]);
8112        assert_eq!(
8113            kernel.requested.len(),
8114            1,
8115            "the second injection is not made"
8116        );
8117        assert_eq!(kernel.pending, kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH));
8118        assert_eq!(wait.held.map(|held| held.kind), Some(HeldKind::Precious));
8119    }
8120
8121    /// A wait whose `block` was stopped by a default `SIGCHLD`, which the
8122    /// backend holds as a signal whose loss matters (`HeldKind::Precious`).
8123    async fn wait_holding_sigchld(guest: &mut WaitGuest, kernel: &Kernel) -> KernelSignalWait {
8124        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&*guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8125        wait.block(guest, None).await.unwrap();
8126        assert_eq!(
8127            wait.held.map(|held| (held.signal, held.kind)),
8128            Some((libc::SIGCHLD, HeldKind::Precious))
8129        );
8130        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8131        assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, blocked_signal_mask() | guest_mask());
8132        assert_eq!(kernel.held_slot, Some(libc::SIGCHLD));
8133        wait
8134    }
8135
8136    /// A signal that `/proc` never showed, a `SIGSTOP` sent from outside here,
8137    /// stops the injection that puts the guest's mask back before it runs, and
8138    /// the next attempt runs. The backend holds one signal, so the `SIGSTOP`
8139    /// replaced the held `SIGCHLD`, and `restore` used to return success, so
8140    /// the guest resumed without its `SIGCHLD` (round-11 High F1 on
8141    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361). The mask is still put
8142    /// back, and the wait now ends with a `HeldSignalRefusal`.
8143    #[tokio::test]
8144    async fn a_stop_of_the_mask_restoration_that_replaces_a_held_sigchld_is_refused() {
8145        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGCHLD), 0);
8146        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8147        let mut wait = wait_holding_sigchld(&mut guest, &kernel).await;
8148        kernel
8149            .lock()
8150            .unwrap()
8151            .outcomes
8152            .push_back(MaskOutcome::StoppedBy(libc::SIGSTOP));
8153
8154        let result = wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await;
8155
8156        {
8157            let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8158            assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, guest_mask(), "the guest's mask is back");
8159            assert_eq!(
8160                kernel.requested[2..],
8161                [guest_mask(), guest_mask()],
8162                "one stopped restoration attempt and one that ran"
8163            );
8164            assert_eq!(kernel.held_slot, Some(libc::SIGSTOP));
8165            assert_eq!(kernel.lost, vec![libc::SIGCHLD]);
8166        }
8167        assert_eq!(
8168            refusal(result),
8169            HeldSignalRefusal {
8170                wait: None,
8171                held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8172                replacing: None,
8173                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Restoration,
8174            }
8175        );
8176    }
8177
8178    /// The same with a signal that `/proc` shows before the restoration and
8179    /// that the all-blocked mask leaves unblocked: signal 32, which the C
8180    /// library reserves and leaves out of the blockable set. The refusal names
8181    /// it.
8182    #[tokio::test]
8183    async fn an_identified_stop_of_the_mask_restoration_that_replaces_a_held_sigchld_is_refused() {
8184        const RESERVED: i32 = 32;
8185        assert_eq!(blocked_signal_mask() & kernel_sigset_bit(RESERVED), 0);
8186        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGCHLD), 0);
8187        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8188        let mut wait = wait_holding_sigchld(&mut guest, &kernel).await;
8189        kernel.lock().unwrap().pending = kernel_sigset_bit(RESERVED);
8190
8191        let result = wait.restore(&mut guest, None).await;
8192
8193        {
8194            let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8195            assert_eq!(kernel.blocked, guest_mask(), "the guest's mask is back");
8196            assert_eq!(kernel.taken, vec![libc::SIGCHLD, RESERVED]);
8197            assert_eq!(kernel.held_slot, Some(RESERVED));
8198            assert_eq!(kernel.lost, vec![libc::SIGCHLD]);
8199        }
8200        let refused = refusal(result);
8201        assert_eq!(
8202            refused,
8203            HeldSignalRefusal {
8204                wait: None,
8205                held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8206                replacing: Some(RESERVED),
8207                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Restoration,
8208            }
8209        );
8210        let message = refused.to_string();
8211        assert!(
8212            message.starts_with(
8213                "unsupported: the a blocking wait cannot keep the held signal SIGCHLD: signal 32 \
8214                 stopped the injection that puts the guest's signal mask back and replaced it"
8215            ),
8216            "{message}"
8217        );
8218    }
8219
8220    /// A refusal from the mask restoration replaces the wait's result, whether
8221    /// that is a value or an errno, unless the wait already ended with a refusal
8222    /// of its own, which came first. A mask that could not be put back still
8223    /// ends the run.
8224    #[test]
8225    fn a_restoration_refusal_replaces_the_result_unless_the_wait_refused_first() {
8226        let tool = |refusal: HeldSignalRefusal| Error::Tool(anyhow::Error::new(refusal));
8227        let restoration = HeldSignalRefusal {
8228            wait: None,
8229            held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8230            replacing: None,
8231            loss: HeldSignalLoss::Restoration,
8232        };
8233        let replaced = HeldSignalRefusal {
8234            wait: None,
8235            held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8236            replacing: Some(libc::SIGUSR1),
8237            loss: HeldSignalLoss::Replaced,
8238        };
8239        let not_restored = BlockedWaitSignalError::MaskNotRestored {
8240            pid: Pid::from_raw(1),
8241            tid: Pid::from_raw(1),
8242            attempts: 16,
8243            last_error: Some(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR),
8244        };
8245
8246        assert_eq!(result_after_restore(Ok(()), Ok(3)).unwrap().unwrap(), 3);
8247        assert_eq!(
8248            refusal(result_after_restore(Err(tool(restoration)), Ok(3)).unwrap()),
8249            restoration
8250        );
8251        assert_eq!(
8252            refusal(
8253                result_after_restore(Err(tool(restoration)), Err(Errno::ERESTARTSYS.into()))
8254                    .unwrap()
8255            ),
8256            restoration
8257        );
8258        assert_eq!(
8259            refusal(result_after_restore(Err(tool(restoration)), Err(tool(replaced))).unwrap()),
8260            replaced
8261        );
8262        assert_eq!(
8263            diagnostic(result_after_restore(
8264                Err(Error::Tool(anyhow::Error::new(not_restored))),
8265                Ok(3)
8266            )),
8267            not_restored
8268        );
8269    }

8271    /// A guest whose next `stops` injections are stopped by a signal that
8272    /// `/proc` never shows, as one that arrives after the read before an
8273    /// injection and that the backend then holds: nothing leaves a queue, so the
8274    /// stop cannot be identified.
8275    fn unidentified_stops_guest(stops: usize) -> (WaitGuest, Kernel) {
8276        let (guest, kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
8277        kernel.lock().unwrap().outcomes =
8278            std::iter::repeat_n(MaskOutcome::StoppedBefore, stops).collect();
8279        (guest, kernel)
8280    }
8281
8282    /// A stop that cannot be identified, such as a default-ignored `SIGCHLD`
8283    /// that arrives after the read, used to end the wait with `ERESTARTNOHAND`
8284    /// for a call whose restart code is not a kernel restart code. With no
8285    /// handler to run, the call then restarted, and a relative `poll` timeout
8286    /// or a timed polling `FUTEX_WAIT` started again with a fresh deadline
8287    /// (round-8 High 1 on https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361). The
8288    /// stop is now held and the injection runs again, so the wait goes on with
8289    /// its absolute deadline, as the blind retry before this machinery did.
8290    #[tokio::test]
8291    async fn a_stop_that_cannot_be_identified_keeps_a_timed_wait_and_its_deadline() {
8292        for deadline in [true, false] {
8293            let (mut guest, kernel) = unidentified_stops_guest(1);
8294            let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8295            let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, true, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND)
8296                .with_deadline(deadline);
8297
8298            let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8299
8300            assert!(
8301                matches!(result, Ok(Ok(0))),
8302                "deadline={deadline}: {result:?}"
8303            );
8304            assert_eq!(
8305                kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.len(),
8306                2,
8307                "deadline={deadline}"
8308            );
8309            assert_eq!(wait.held, None, "deadline={deadline}");
8310        }
8311    }
8312
8313    /// A wait with a deadline absorbs stops without the bound that ends any
8314    /// other wait after `MAX_ABSORBED_STOPS`, because a restart would start its
8315    /// timeout again (round-8 High 1 on
8316    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361). A wait without one still
8317    /// ends at the bound, and, while the backend holds only a signal whose loss
8318    /// does not matter (an ignored `SIGUSR1` sent again and again here), with
8319    /// `ERESTARTNOINTR`: it is not refused.
8320    #[tokio::test]
8321    async fn only_a_wait_without_a_deadline_ends_after_the_absorbed_stop_bound() {
8322        let stops = 100;
8323        let usr1 = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
8324        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(usr1, usr1);
8325        kernel.lock().unwrap().repost_after_take = stops - 1;
8326        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8327        let mut wait =
8328            KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, true, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND).with_deadline(true);
8329        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8330        assert!(matches!(result, Ok(Ok(0))), "{result:?}");
8331        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.len(), stops + 1);
8332        assert_eq!(wait.held.map(|held| held.kind), Some(HeldKind::Harmless));
8333
8334        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(usr1, usr1);
8335        kernel.lock().unwrap().repost_after_take = stops - 1;
8336        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8337        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, true, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND);
8338        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8339        assert!(
8340            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR))),
8341            "{result:?}"
8342        );
8343        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.len(), 65);
8344    }

8346    /// At the same bound, a wait without a deadline whose backend holds a

8372    /// At the same bound, a stop that cannot be identified, after stops by a
8373    /// signal whose loss does not matter (an ignored `SIGUSR1` sent again and
8374    /// again), used to end a wait without a deadline with `ERESTARTNOINTR`,
8375    /// which let the backend deliver the unidentified signal, possibly a
8376    /// `SIGCHLD`, at a moment host timing could set. It now ends with a
8377    /// `HeldSignalRefusal`; a wait with a deadline, which has no bound, goes on
8378    /// (round-10 High 1 on https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361).
8379    #[tokio::test]
8380    async fn an_unidentified_stop_at_the_stop_bound_is_refused() {
8381        let usr1 = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
8382        for deadline in [false, true] {
8383            let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(usr1, usr1);
8384            {
8385                let mut kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8386                // 64 identified stops, the bound, then one that `/proc` never
8387                // shows.
8388                kernel.repost_after_take = 63;
8389                kernel.outcomes = VecDeque::from([MaskOutcome::StoppedBefore]);
8390            }
8391            let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8392            let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, true, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND)
8393                .with_deadline(deadline);
8394
8395            let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8396
8397            if deadline {
8398                assert!(matches!(result, Ok(Ok(0))), "{result:?}");
8399                assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.len(), 66);
8400                assert!(wait.held_unidentified);
8401            } else {
8402                assert_eq!(
8403                    refusal(result),
8404                    HeldSignalRefusal {
8405                        wait: None,
8406                        held: None,
8407                        replacing: None,
8408                        loss: HeldSignalLoss::StopBound,
8409                    }
8410                );
8411                assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.len(), 65);
8412            }
8413            assert_eq!(
8414                kernel.lock().unwrap().taken.len(),
8415                64,
8416                "deadline={deadline}"
8417            );
8418        }
8419    }

8421    /// A stop that cannot be identified while the backend holds a `SIGCHLD`
8422    /// replaced the `SIGCHLD` in the backend's one slot. The wait used to go on
8423    /// and lose it; it now ends with a `HeldSignalRefusal`, with or without a

8429            kernel.lock().unwrap().outcomes = VecDeque::from([MaskOutcome::StoppedBefore]);
8430            let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);

8432                KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS).with_deadline(deadline);

8437                refusal(result),

8439                    wait: None,

8479                "deadline={deadline}"
8480            );
8481        }
8482    }
8483
8484    /// A `SIGCHLD` that arrives after the read before an injection stops it in a
8485    /// way that cannot be identified, and a second one, pending at the next
8486    /// read, would stop the injection made again and replace the first in the
8487    /// backend's one slot. The first may have been a signal whose loss matters,
8488    /// so the wait is refused before that injection, with or without a
8489    /// deadline (round-10 High 1 on https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361),
8490    /// and the backend still holds the first signal. This is the refusal a
8491    /// flood of external `SIGCHLD` racing a timed futex wait's first injections
8492    /// met on hermit main ccbe5ae8 (`external_signal_interrupt`'s test of the
8493    /// flood, now
8494    /// `ptrace_timed_futex_wait_and_poll_keep_their_deadline_after_a_sigchld_flood`,
8495    /// which sends its flood before the wait starts).
8496    #[tokio::test]
8497    async fn a_sigchld_after_an_unidentified_stop_is_refused_before_it_replaces_it() {
8498        let chld = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGCHLD);
8499        for deadline in [true, false] {
8500            let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(0, 0);
8501            {
8502                let mut kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8503                // Pending only after the first read: the injection's stop is not
8504                // identified. Sent once more, so it is pending again at the read
8505                // before the injection made again.
8506                kernel.pending_repost = chld;
8507                kernel.repost_after_take = 1;
8508            }
8509            let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8510            let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, true, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND)
8511                .with_deadline(deadline);
8512
8513            let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8514
8515            let refused = refusal(result);
8516            assert_eq!(
8517                refused,
8518                HeldSignalRefusal {
8519                    wait: None,
8520                    held: None,
8521                    replacing: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8522                    loss: HeldSignalLoss::Replaced,
8523                },
8524                "deadline={deadline}"
8525            );
8526            let message = HeldSignalRefusal {
8527                wait: Some(Sysno::futex),
8528                ..refused
8529            }
8530            .to_string();
8531            assert!(
8532                message.starts_with(
8533                    "unsupported: the futex wait cannot keep a held signal that could not be \
8534                     identified: the pending SIGCHLD would stop the next injection and replace it"
8535                ),
8536                "deadline={deadline}: {message}"
8537            );
8538            assert!(wait.held_unidentified, "deadline={deadline}");
8539            let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8540            assert_eq!(
8541                kernel.requested.len(),
8542                1,
8543                "deadline={deadline}: the second injection is not made"
8544            );
8545            assert_eq!(kernel.taken, vec![libc::SIGCHLD], "deadline={deadline}");
8546            assert_eq!(kernel.held_slot, Some(libc::SIGCHLD), "deadline={deadline}");
8547            assert!(kernel.lost.is_empty(), "deadline={deadline}");
8548            assert_eq!(kernel.pending, chld, "deadline={deadline}");
8549        }
8550    }
8551
8552    /// In a wait with a deadline, a held `SIGCHLD` that would not end the wait
8553    /// is not dropped when another pending signal would stop the next
8554    /// injection. The injection used to be made, and the stop replaced the held
8555    /// signal, as the blind retry allowed (round-8 High 1 on
8556    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361); a restart would start the
8557    /// timeout again. The wait now ends with a `HeldSignalRefusal` before the
8558    /// injection (round-10 High 1 on the same pull request).
8559    #[tokio::test]
8560    async fn a_timed_wait_refuses_to_let_another_stop_replace_a_held_sigchld() {
8561        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(
8562            kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGCHLD) | kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH),
8563            0,
8564        );
8565        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8566        let mut wait =
8567            KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND).with_deadline(true);
8568
8569        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8570
8571        assert_eq!(
8572            refusal(result),
8573            HeldSignalRefusal {
8574                wait: None,
8575                held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8576                replacing: Some(libc::SIGWINCH),
8577                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Replaced,
8578            }
8579        );
8580        let kernel = kernel.lock().unwrap();
8581        assert_eq!(kernel.taken, vec![libc::SIGCHLD]);
8582        assert_eq!(
8583            kernel.requested.len(),
8584            1,
8585            "the second injection is not made"
8586        );
8587        assert_eq!(kernel.pending, kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH));
8588    }

8590    /// In a wait with a deadline, a held signal that would end the wait natively
8591    /// ends it with the restart errno before another stop can replace it, as
8592    /// Linux ends the wait for that signal.
8593    #[tokio::test]
8594    async fn a_timed_wait_ends_for_a_held_signal_that_would_end_it() {
8595        let usr1 = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
8596        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(usr1 | kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH), 0);
8597        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8598        let mut wait =
8599            KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, 0, false, Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND).with_deadline(true);
8600        wait.held = Some(HeldSignal {
8601            signal: libc::SIGUSR1,
8602            queue: SignalQueue::Thread,
8603            kind: HeldKind::Precious,
8604        });
8605        kernel.lock().unwrap().pending = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGWINCH);
8606        kernel.lock().unwrap().caught = usr1;
8607
8608        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8609
8610        assert!(
8611            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOHAND))),
8612            "{result:?}"
8613        );

8615            kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.is_empty(),
8616            "nothing is injected"
8617        );

8621    /// natively also ends it with the restart errno before another stop can

8623    /// `ERESTARTNOINTR`, which restarted the call after the handler ran

8635            kind: HeldKind::Precious,

8639

8641            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTSYS))),
8642            "{result:?}"

8645            kernel.lock().unwrap().requested.is_empty(),
8646            "nothing is injected"
8647        );

8650    /// A signal that a wait without a deadline consumes and that stops an
8651    /// injection is delivered rather than returned. One whose loss does not
8652    /// matter still ends the wait with `ERESTARTNOINTR`, and is not refused;
8653    /// a `SIGCHLD`, which the wait holds until the call returns, used to end it
8654    /// the same way and now ends it with a `HeldSignalRefusal` (round-10 High 1
8655    /// on https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361).
8656    #[tokio::test]
8657    async fn a_consumed_sigchld_that_stops_an_injection_is_refused() {
8658        let usr1 = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);

8660        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8661        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, usr1, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8662        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8663        assert!(
8664            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR))),
8665            "{result:?}"
8666        );
8667        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().taken, vec![libc::SIGUSR1]);
8668        drop(_proc);
8669
8670        let chld = kernel_sigset_bit(libc::SIGCHLD);
8671        let (mut guest, kernel) = stopping_guest(chld, 0);
8672        let _proc = scripted_proc(&kernel);
8673        let mut wait = KernelSignalWait::new(&guest, chld, false, Errno::ERESTARTSYS);
8674        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8675        assert_eq!(
8676            refusal(result),
8677            HeldSignalRefusal {
8678                wait: None,
8679                held: None,
8680                replacing: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8681                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Consumed,
8682            }
8683        );
8684        assert_eq!(kernel.lock().unwrap().taken, vec![libc::SIGCHLD]);

8687    /// A stop by a signal outside every class above, such as the backend's own
8688    /// preemption signal, still ends a wait without a deadline with

8691    #[tokio::test]
8692    async fn a_stop_by_the_preemption_signal_still_restarts_a_wait_without_a_deadline() {
8693        let signal = reverie::PERF_EVENT_SIGNAL as i32;

8697
8698        let result = inject_mask_absorbing(&mut wait, &mut guest, guest_mask()).await;
8699
8700        assert!(
8701            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR))),

8707    /// A wait that ends with a `HeldSignalRefusal` is refused through the
8708    /// unsupported-operation policy that `refuse_unserviceable_operation`
8709    /// applies: a run that is not fail-closed gets the `ERESTARTNOINTR` restart
8710    /// it got before, and a fail-closed one with `exit_on_unsupported_syscall`
8711    /// ends with the typed `UnsupportedSyscallError` for the wait's call. Every
8712    /// other result passes through, and the message names the wait, the
8713    /// signals and the pull request.
8714    #[tokio::test]
8715    async fn a_held_signal_refusal_follows_the_unsupported_operation_policy() {
8716        let refused = || {
8717            Err::<i64, Error>(Error::Tool(anyhow::Error::new(HeldSignalRefusal {
8718                wait: None,
8719                held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8720                replacing: Some(libc::SIGWINCH),
8721                loss: HeldSignalLoss::Replaced,
8722            })))
8723        };
8724        let (mut guest, _kernel) = WaitGuest::live(guest_mask());
8725        guest.config.panic_on_unsupported_syscalls = false;
8726        let result = refuse_held_signal_loss(&mut guest, Sysno::poll, refused()).await;
8727        assert!(
8728            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTNOINTR))),
8729            "{result:?}"
8730        );
8731        let result = refuse_held_signal_loss(&mut guest, Sysno::poll, Ok(3)).await;
8732        assert!(matches!(result, Ok(3)), "{result:?}");
8733        let result =
8734            refuse_held_signal_loss(&mut guest, Sysno::poll, Err(Errno::ERESTARTSYS.into())).await;
8735        assert!(
8736            matches!(result, Err(Error::Errno(Errno::ERESTARTSYS))),
8737            "{result:?}"
8738        );
8739
8740        guest.config.panic_on_unsupported_syscalls = true;
8741        guest.config.exit_on_unsupported_syscall = true;
8742        guest.config.shutdown_on_unsupported_syscall = false;
8743        let result = refuse_held_signal_loss(&mut guest, Sysno::poll, refused()).await;
8744        match result {
8745            Err(Error::Tool(error)) => assert!(
8746                matches!(
8747                    error.downcast_ref::<crate::UnsupportedSyscallError>(),
8748                    Some(crate::UnsupportedSyscallError(Sysno::poll))
8749                ),
8750                "{error:#}"
8751            ),
8752            other => panic!("expected the typed refusal, got {other:?}"),
8753        }
8754
8755        let message = HeldSignalRefusal {
8756            wait: Some(Sysno::poll),
8757            held: Some(libc::SIGCHLD),
8758            replacing: Some(libc::SIGWINCH),
8759            loss: HeldSignalLoss::Replaced,
8760        }
8761        .to_string();
8762        for part in [
8763            "poll",
8764            "SIGCHLD",
8765            "SIGWINCH",
8766            "https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/pull/3361",
8767        ] {
8768            assert!(message.contains(part), "{part} missing from: {message}");
8769        }
8770    }
